name: app.R
content:
# =============================================================================
# app.R — GC calculator: geocomplexity of spatial variables (Shinylive)
# =============================================================================
# Upload any CSV of point observations, assign the variable roles in the
# sidebar (location + the variables to measure) — column names are free;
# common names (ID/lon/lat) are pre-selected automatically. Everything runs
# in the visitor's browser via webR; no data leaves their device.
# Method: Zhang, Song, Luo & Wu (2023), IJGIS, doi:10.1080/13658816.2023.2203212,
# as implemented by geocomplexity::geocd_vector(method = "moran").
# =============================================================================

library(shiny)
source("gc-core.R")

CURVE_COL   <- "#D7301F"
POINT_COL   <- grDevices::adjustcolor("grey35", 0.45)
PALETTE_GC   <- c("#FFF7EC", "#FDD49E", "#FC8D59", "#D7301F", "#7F0000")
PALETTE_DATA <- c("#F7FBFF", "#C6DBEF", "#6BAED6", "#2171B5", "#08306B")
MAX_POINTS  <- 10000
MIN_POINTS  <- 30
EXAMPLE_CSV <- "gc-example-simulated.csv"

# -- UI -----------------------------------------------------------------------

ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
    body { max-width: 1150px; margin: auto; }
    h2 { margin-top: 18px; }
    .well { background: #f7f9fb; }
    .note { color: #555; font-size: 13px; }
    .cite { color: #555; font-size: 15px; border-left: 3px solid #47695B;
            padding-left: 10px; margin: 8px 0 22px 0; }
    .citehead { color: #333; font-size: 15px; margin: 22px 0 4px 0; }
    .dlrow { margin: 4px 0 18px 0; }
    .dlrow .btn { margin-right: 6px; }
    .scrollx { overflow-x: auto; }
    .scrollx table { font-size: 11.5px; white-space: nowrap; }
    .varlab { font-weight: 600; margin: 10px 0 2px 0; }
    table.data { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .gc-hex-zoom { transition: transform 0.15s ease; }
    .gc-hex-zoom:hover { transform: scale(1.12); }
  ")),
  # A plot rendered while the tab is in the background gets width 0 and shows
  # an error; nudge Shiny to re-measure when the tab becomes visible again.
  tags$script(HTML("
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
      if (!document.hidden) {
        setTimeout(function() { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); }, 250);
      }
    });
  ")),
  # Browsers bypass the service worker for <a download> navigations (HTML
  # spec: downloads have service-workers mode 'none'), so in Shinylive the
  # native download click reaches the static host and 404s. Fetch the file
  # through the service worker instead and hand it over as a blob.
  tags$script(HTML("
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var a = e.target && e.target.closest('a.shiny-download-link');
      if (!a || !a.getAttribute('href')) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      fetch(a.href).then(function(resp) {
        if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + resp.status);
        var cd = resp.headers.get('content-disposition') || '';
        var m = /filename\\*?=(?:UTF-8'')?\"?([^\";]+)\"?/i.exec(cd);
        var filename = m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : (a.download || 'download');
        return resp.blob().then(function(blob) {
          var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          var tmp = document.createElement('a');
          tmp.href = url;
          tmp.download = filename;
          document.body.appendChild(tmp);
          tmp.click();
          tmp.remove();
          setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 4000);
        });
      }).catch(function(err) {
        alert('Download failed: ' + err.message +
              '. Compute the results first, then try again.');
      });
    }, true);
  "))),

  div(style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin:18px 0 10px 0;",
    a(href = "https://yongzesong.com/app/gc/", class = "gc-hex-zoom",
      style = "flex:0 0 auto; line-height:0;",
      title = "GC calculator",
      HTML('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 220" width="62" height="68" role="img" aria-label="GC hex logo"><path d="M100,10 L187,60 L187,160 L100,210 L13,160 L13,60 Z" fill="#F6F2E9" stroke="#47695B" stroke-width="8" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="102" y="82" text-anchor="middle" font-family="\'Source Sans Pro\',\'Helvetica Neue\',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="40" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="6" fill="#3B5348">GC</text><line x1="34" y1="168" x2="166" y2="168" stroke="#A9BCA9" stroke-width="2.5"/><polyline points="34,168 48,124 60,152 74,106 88,146 102,116 116,158 130,122 144,150 166,112" fill="none" stroke="#86AC98" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>')),
    h2("GC calculator — geocomplexity of spatial variables",
       style = "margin:0;")),
  p(class = "citehead",
    "To cite geocomplexity (GC) in publications, please use:"),
  div(class = "cite",
    "Zhang, Z., Song, Y., Luo, P., & Wu, P. (2023). Geocomplexity explains ",
    "spatial errors. ",
    em("International Journal of Geographical Information Science, 37"),
    "(7), 1449–1469. ",
    a(href = "https://doi.org/10.1080/13658816.2023.2203212", target = "_blank",
      "doi:10.1080/13658816.2023.2203212")),
  p(class = "note",
    "Computes, for every selected variable, its spatial-dependence ",
    "geocomplexity — how strongly each location departs from the smooth ",
    "spatial dependence of its neighbourhood. Identical to ",
    code("geocomplexity::geocd_vector(method = \"moran\")"), " (",
    a(href = "https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=geocomplexity",
      target = "_blank", "CRAN package"),
    "). All computation runs locally in your browser (WebAssembly R); ",
    "your data is never uploaded to any server."),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(width = 4,
      h4("1 · Data"),
      fileInput("file", "Upload CSV", accept = c(".csv", "text/csv")),
      div(class = "note",
        "Point observations, one row per location: an optional ID column, ",
        "coordinates in WGS84 degrees, and one or more numeric variables ",
        "(", code("ID, lon, lat, x1, x2, …"), "). Column names are free — ",
        "assign the roles below after loading. Recommended size: fewer than ",
        "10,000 rows."),
      actionButton("example", "Load example data", class = "btn-sm"),
      downloadButton("dl_sample", "Sample CSV", class = "btn-sm"),
      div(class = "note", style = "margin-top: 4px;",
        "The example is a simulated dataset of 400 points (columns ID, ",
        "lon, lat, x1–x5) with five variables of deliberately different ",
        "spatial structure — x1 smooth gradient, x2 autocorrelated field, ",
        "x3 local hotspots, x4 field + noise, x5 pure noise — so the ",
        "geocomplexity output spans the whole range."),
      hr(),

      h4("2 · Settings — variables"),
      div(class = "varlab", "Location (lon, lat)"),
      fluidRow(
        column(6, selectInput("var_lon", NULL, choices = c("lon…" = ""))),
        column(6, selectInput("var_lat", NULL, choices = c("lat…" = "")))
      ),
      div(class = "varlab", "Variables to measure (x)"),
      selectInput("var_x", NULL, choices = character(0), multiple = TRUE,
                  selectize = TRUE),
      div(class = "note",
        "Geocomplexity is computed for each selected variable ",
        "independently. ID and unselected columns are carried through to ",
        "the results table unchanged."),
      hr(),

      h4("3 · Settings — parameters"),
      numericInput("k", "k nearest neighbours",
                   value = 6, min = 2, max = 30, step = 1),
      div(class = "note",
        "Neighbourhood for the local complexity measure: k nearest points ",
        "by great-circle distance, binary weights. The default k = 6 is ",
        "the geocomplexity package's default for point layers."),
      hr(),

      h4("4 · Compute"),
      actionButton("compute", "Compute geocomplexity", class = "btn-primary")
    ),

    mainPanel(width = 8,
      h4("Data preview — first 6 rows"),
      uiOutput("preview_ui"),
      h4("Data summary"),
      verbatimTextOutput("summary", placeholder = TRUE),

      h4("Spatial distribution of the loaded data"),
      div(class = "note",
        "One panel per selected variable, coloured by its value (each panel ",
        "has its own colour range)."),
      uiOutput("maps_data_ui"),
      div(class = "dlrow",
          downloadButton("dl_map_data_png", "Data maps PNG"),
          downloadButton("dl_map_data_pdf", "Data maps PDF (vector)")),

      h4("Geocomplexity results"),
      div(class = "note",
        "Your original data with one geocomplexity column added per ",
        "selected variable (GC ∈ [0, 1], min–max normalized; higher = the ",
        "location departs more from the smooth spatial dependence of its ",
        "neighbourhood). The page shows the first 10 rows; the CSV holds ",
        "all rows."),
      uiOutput("table_ui"),
      div(class = "dlrow", downloadButton("dl_table", "Results CSV (all rows)")),

      h4("Spatial distribution of geocomplexity"),
      div(class = "note",
        "One panel per variable, coloured by its geocomplexity ",
        "(GC ∈ [0, 1]; the colour scale is fixed to [0, 1], so the panels ",
        "are comparable across variables)."),
      uiOutput("maps_gc_ui"),
      div(class = "dlrow",
          downloadButton("dl_map_gc_png", "GC maps PNG"),
          downloadButton("dl_map_gc_pdf", "GC maps PDF (vector)")),

      h4("Variable–geocomplexity curves"),
      div(class = "note",
        "One panel per selected variable: observations (dots) and a loess ",
        "fit (line) of geocomplexity on the variable's value. The curve ",
        "shows which value ranges of the variable sit in spatially complex ",
        "surroundings."),
      uiOutput("curves_ui"),
      div(class = "dlrow",
          downloadButton("dl_fig_png", "Curves PNG"),
          downloadButton("dl_fig_pdf", "Curves PDF (vector)"))
    )
  ),

  tags$details(style = "margin: 16px 0;",
    tags$summary("Method notes & data format"),
    tags$ul(
      tags$li("Geocomplexity (spatial-dependence form): each variable is ",
              "standardized (z-score), the local complexity of every ",
              "location is measured by the local Moran decomposition of ",
              "Zhang et al. (2023), and the result is min–max normalized ",
              "to [0, 1]. This reproduces ",
              code("geocomplexity::geocd_vector(method = \"moran\", normalize = TRUE)"),
              " to machine precision (see the project's validation report)."),
      tags$li("Neighbourhood: k nearest neighbours with binary weights; ",
              "distances are great-circle on the WGS-84 ellipsoid ",
              "(Andoyer–Lambert — the same formula as spdep, so neighbour ",
              "sets match spdep/sdsfun exactly). Default k = 6, the package ",
              "default for point layers."),
      tags$li("Curves: loess (degree 2, span 0.75) of GC on the raw ",
              "variable value; the dots are the individual observations."),
      tags$li("Rows with missing values in any selected column are dropped ",
              "and reported. Constant variables have undefined ",
              "geocomplexity and are rejected."),
      tags$li("Coordinates must be WGS84 degrees; the in-browser version is ",
              "limited to 10,000 points.")
    ))
)

# -- Server -------------------------------------------------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  raw <- reactiveVal(NULL)   # list(df, label)

  numericish <- function(v) is.numeric(v) ||
    !all(is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))))

  # Load a data frame, then pre-select variable roles from common column names.
  populate <- function(df, label) {
    names(df) <- trimws(names(df))
    raw(list(df = df, label = label))
    cols    <- names(df)
    numcols <- cols[vapply(df, numericish, logical(1))]
    guess1 <- function(pat) {
      m <- numcols[grepl(pat, numcols, ignore.case = TRUE)]
      if (length(m)) m[1] else ""
    }
    g_lon <- guess1("^(lon|long|longitude)$")
    g_lat <- guess1("^(lat|latitude)$")
    g_id  <- cols[cols == "" | grepl("^id$", cols, ignore.case = TRUE)]
    g_x   <- setdiff(numcols, c(g_lon, g_lat, g_id))

    updateSelectInput(session, "var_lon", choices = c("lon…" = "", cols),
                      selected = g_lon)
    updateSelectInput(session, "var_lat", choices = c("lat…" = "", cols),
                      selected = g_lat)
    updateSelectInput(session, "var_x", choices = cols, selected = g_x)
  }

  observeEvent(input$example, {
    populate(utils::read.csv(EXAMPLE_CSV, check.names = FALSE),
             "Simulated example (5 variables, n = 400)")
  })

  observeEvent(input$file, {
    df <- tryCatch(utils::read.csv(input$file$datapath, check.names = FALSE),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df)) {
      showNotification("Could not read that file as CSV.", type = "error")
    } else {
      populate(df, input$file$name)
    }
  })

  # Current variable selection, validated.
  selection <- reactive({
    r <- raw()
    validate(need(!is.null(r), "Load the example data or upload a CSV first."))
    lon <- input$var_lon; lat <- input$var_lat; xv <- input$var_x
    validate(
      need(nzchar(lon), "Select the longitude column (Settings — variables)."),
      need(nzchar(lat), "Select the latitude column (Settings — variables)."),
      need(length(xv) >= 1,
           "Select at least one variable to measure (Settings — variables)."),
      need(lon != lat,
           "Longitude and latitude must be two different columns."),
      need(!any(c(lon, lat) %in% xv),
           "The variables to measure must be different from the location columns.")
    )
    list(lon = lon, lat = lat, x = xv)
  })

  # Working dataset built from the selection: numeric, complete rows only.
  # All original columns are kept (for the results CSV); completeness is
  # judged on the selected columns.
  built <- reactive({
    r <- raw(); s <- selection()
    used <- c(s$lon, s$lat, s$x)
    df <- r$df
    bad <- used[!vapply(df[, used, drop = FALSE], numericish, logical(1))]
    validate(need(!length(bad), paste0(
      "Selected column(s) not numeric: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "))))
    for (cc in used) df[[cc]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[cc]]))
    keep <- stats::complete.cases(df[, used, drop = FALSE])
    df <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    validate(
      need(nrow(df) >= MIN_POINTS, paste0("Only ", nrow(df), " complete rows — at ",
        "least ", MIN_POINTS, " are needed for a meaningful geocomplexity.")),
      need(nrow(df) <= MAX_POINTS, paste0(nrow(df), " rows exceeds the ",
        "current limit of ", MAX_POINTS, " points for the in-browser version.")),
      need(all(abs(df[[s$lon]]) <= 360) && all(abs(df[[s$lat]]) <= 90),
        "Location values outside valid degree ranges — are these projected coordinates? This tool expects WGS84 degrees.")
    )
    const <- s$x[vapply(s$x, function(v) stats::sd(df[[v]]) == 0, logical(1))]
    validate(need(!length(const), paste0(
      "Constant variable(s) — geocomplexity is undefined: ",
      paste(const, collapse = ", "))))
    list(df = df, sel = s, dropped = sum(!keep), label = r$label)
  })

  result <- eventReactive(input$compute, {
    b <- built(); df <- b$df; s <- b$sel
    k <- min(max(2, as.integer(input$k)), nrow(df) - 1)
    validate(need(is.finite(k) && k >= 2, "k must be at least 2."))

    withProgress(message = "Computing geocomplexity…", value = 0, {
      incProgress(0.05, detail = sprintf("k-nearest neighbours (n = %d)", nrow(df)))
      nb <- knn_neighbors(df[[s$lon]], df[[s$lat]], k)
      step <- 0.9 / length(s$x)
      gc <- list()
      for (v in s$x) {
        incProgress(step, detail = paste("GC of", v))
        gc[[paste0("GC_", v)]] <- gc_moran(df[[v]], nb)
      }
      gc <- as.data.frame(gc, check.names = FALSE)
      incProgress(0.05)
      list(df = df, gc = gc, sel = s, k = k,
           dropped = b$dropped, label = b$label)
    })
  })

  # -- Data preview and summary ----------------------------------------------

  output$preview_ui <- renderUI({
    if (is.null(raw())) {
      return(div(class = "note", "Load the example data or upload a CSV to ",
                 "see its first rows and columns here."))
    }
    div(class = "scrollx", tableOutput("preview"))
  })

  output$preview <- renderTable({
    r <- raw(); req(r)
    utils::head(r$df, 6)
  }, striped = TRUE, digits = 3, class = "data")

  output$summary <- renderText({
    r <- raw()
    if (is.null(r)) return("No data loaded yet.")
    s <- tryCatch(selection(), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(s)) {
      return(sprintf("Source: %s\nRows: %d, columns: %d\nAssign the variable roles in [2 · Settings — variables].",
                     r$label, nrow(r$df), ncol(r$df)))
    }
    base <- sprintf(
      "Source: %s\nLocation: (%s, %s)\nVariables to measure: %s",
      r$label, s$lon, s$lat, paste(s$x, collapse = ", "))
    res <- if (input$compute > 0) tryCatch(result(), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
    if (is.null(res)) return(paste0(base, "\nSet k and press [Compute geocomplexity]."))
    sprintf("%s\nComputed: %d points (%d dropped), k = %d nearest neighbours, great-circle distances.",
            base, nrow(res$df), res$dropped, res$k)
  })

  # -- Results table ----------------------------------------------------------

  result_table <- reactive({
    r <- result()
    cbind(r$df, r$gc)
  })

  output$table_ui <- renderUI({
    req(result())
    div(class = "scrollx", tableOutput("table_head"))
  })

  output$table_head <- renderTable({
    utils::head(result_table(), 10)
  }, striped = TRUE, digits = 3, class = "data")

  # -- Maps -------------------------------------------------------------------

  # One square-frame map panel: colour ramp over v, aspect corrected for
  # latitude. Draws into the current mfrow cell; the caller sets par().
  map_panel <- function(lon, lat, v, legend_title, pal_cols,
                        lon_name = "lon", lat_name = "lat",
                        rng = range(v)) {
    pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(pal_cols)(100)
    idx <- if (diff(rng) > 0) {
      pmin(100, pmax(1, 1 + floor(99 * (v - rng[1]) / diff(rng))))
    } else rep(50, length(v))
    plot(lon, lat, col = pal[idx], pch = 16, cex = 0.8,
         xlab = lon_name, ylab = lat_name,
         asp = 1 / cospi(mean(lat) / 180))
    qs <- signif(seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 5), 3)
    legend("topright", bty = "n", cex = 0.7, title = legend_title,
           legend = qs, pch = 16, col = pal[c(1, 25, 50, 75, 100)])
    box()
  }

  # All variables as sub-panels of one figure, same grid as the curves.
  maps_data_fun <- function(df, s) {
    nv <- length(s$x)
    nc <- min(3, nv); nr <- ceiling(nv / nc)
    op <- par(mfrow = c(nr, nc), mar = c(4, 4.2, 1.2, 0.8), pty = "s")
    on.exit(par(op))
    for (v in s$x)
      map_panel(df[[s$lon]], df[[s$lat]], df[[v]], v, PALETTE_DATA,
                lon_name = s$lon, lat_name = s$lat)
  }

  maps_gc_fun <- function(r) {
    s <- r$sel
    nv <- length(s$x)
    nc <- min(3, nv); nr <- ceiling(nv / nc)
    op <- par(mfrow = c(nr, nc), mar = c(4, 4.2, 1.2, 0.8), pty = "s")
    on.exit(par(op))
    for (v in s$x)
      map_panel(r$df[[s$lon]], r$df[[s$lat]], r$gc[[paste0("GC_", v)]],
                paste0("GC_", v), PALETTE_GC,
                lon_name = s$lon, lat_name = s$lat, rng = c(0, 1))
  }

  output$maps_data_ui <- renderUI({
    s <- tryCatch(selection(), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(s)) {
      return(div(class = "note", "The maps appear once the data is loaded ",
                 "and the variable roles are assigned."))
    }
    h <- 60 + 285 * panel_rows(length(s$x))
    plotOutput("maps_data", height = paste0(h, "px"))
  })
  output$maps_data <- renderPlot({
    b <- built()
    maps_data_fun(b$df, b$sel)
  })

  output$maps_gc_ui <- renderUI({
    r <- result()
    h <- 60 + 285 * panel_rows(length(r$sel$x))
    plotOutput("maps_gc", height = paste0(h, "px"))
  })
  output$maps_gc <- renderPlot({ maps_gc_fun(result()) })

  # -- Variable–GC curves -----------------------------------------------------

  curves_plot_fun <- function(df, xvars, gc) {
    nv <- length(xvars)
    nc <- min(3, nv); nr <- ceiling(nv / nc)
    op <- par(mfrow = c(nr, nc), mar = c(4, 4.2, 1.2, 0.8), pty = "s")
    on.exit(par(op))
    for (v in xvars) {
      x <- df[[v]]; g <- gc[[paste0("GC_", v)]]
      plot(x, g, pch = 16, col = POINT_COL, cex = 0.7,
           xlab = v, ylab = "Geocomplexity (GC)", ylim = c(0, 1))
      cv <- gc_loess_curve(x, g)
      lines(cv$x, cv$y, col = CURVE_COL, lwd = 2.2)
      box()
    }
  }

  panel_rows <- function(nv) ceiling(nv / min(3, nv))

  output$curves_ui <- renderUI({
    r <- result()
    h <- 60 + 285 * panel_rows(length(r$sel$x))
    plotOutput("curves", height = paste0(h, "px"))
  })
  output$curves <- renderPlot({
    r <- result()
    curves_plot_fun(r$df, r$sel$x, r$gc)
  })

  # -- Downloads --------------------------------------------------------------

  png_of <- function(draw, w, h) function(f) {
    grDevices::png(f, width = w, height = h, res = 220)
    draw(); grDevices::dev.off()
  }

  # Vector export with the portable pdf() device.
  pdf_of <- function(draw, w_in, h_in) function(f) {
    grDevices::pdf(f, width = w_in, height = h_in, useDingbats = FALSE)
    draw(); grDevices::dev.off()
  }

  output$dl_sample <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() "gc-sample.csv",
    content  = function(f) file.copy(EXAMPLE_CSV, f, overwrite = TRUE))

  output$dl_table <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() "gc-results.csv",
    content  = function(f) utils::write.csv(result_table(), f, row.names = FALSE))

  output$dl_fig_png <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() "gc-curves.png",
    content  = function(f) {
      r <- result()
      nr <- panel_rows(length(r$sel$x))
      png_of(function() curves_plot_fun(r$df, r$sel$x, r$gc),
             2200, 140 + 700 * nr)(f)
    })

  output$dl_fig_pdf <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() "gc-curves.pdf",
    content  = function(f) {
      r <- result()
      nr <- panel_rows(length(r$sel$x))
      pdf_of(function() curves_plot_fun(r$df, r$sel$x, r$gc),
             10.5, 0.6 + 3.4 * nr)(f)
    })

  output$dl_map_data_png <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() "gc-data-maps.png",
    content  = function(f) {
      b <- built()
      nr <- panel_rows(length(b$sel$x))
      png_of(function() maps_data_fun(b$df, b$sel), 2200, 140 + 700 * nr)(f)
    })

  output$dl_map_data_pdf <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() "gc-data-maps.pdf",
    content  = function(f) {
      b <- built()
      nr <- panel_rows(length(b$sel$x))
      pdf_of(function() maps_data_fun(b$df, b$sel), 10.5, 0.6 + 3.4 * nr)(f)
    })

  output$dl_map_gc_png <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() "gc-maps.png",
    content  = function(f) {
      r <- result()
      nr <- panel_rows(length(r$sel$x))
      png_of(function() maps_gc_fun(r), 2200, 140 + 700 * nr)(f)
    })

  output$dl_map_gc_pdf <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() "gc-maps.pdf",
    content  = function(f) {
      r <- result()
      nr <- panel_rows(length(r$sel$x))
      pdf_of(function() maps_gc_fun(r), 10.5, 0.6 + 3.4 * nr)(f)
    })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

name: gc-core.R

# =============================================================================
# gc-core.R — geocomplexity computation core for the browser (base R only)
# =============================================================================
# Reimplements geocomplexity::geocd_vector(method = "moran") — the spatial-
# dependence geocomplexity of Zhang, Song, Luo & Wu (2023), IJGIS 37(7),
# doi:10.1080/13658816.2023.2203212 — without sf/spdep/Rcpp, so the
# WebAssembly payload stays small. The reimplementation reproduces the CRAN
# package to machine precision; see validation/validate.R.
#
# Pipeline per variable (as in geocd_vector):
#   1. standardize:  z = (x - mean) / sd
#   2. local Moran decomposition (C++ VectorGeoCMoran, ported below)
#   3. normalize:    min-max to [0, 1]
# =============================================================================

# -- Neighbourhood ------------------------------------------------------------

# Great-circle distances (km) from one point to a set of points.
# Andoyer-Lambert approximation on the WGS-84 ellipsoid — the same formula as
# spdep's C gcdist() (src/dnn.c), so neighbour sets match spdep::knearneigh
# (longlat = TRUE) exactly, which is what sdsfun/geocomplexity use for point
# layers in a geographic CRS.
gcdist_km <- function(lon0, lat0, lon, lat) {
  rad <- pi / 180
  a  <- 6378.137            # WGS-84 equatorial radius, km
  f  <- 1 / 298.257223563   # WGS-84 flattening

  F <- (lat0 + lat) / 2 * rad
  G <- (lat0 - lat) / 2 * rad
  L <- (lon0 - lon) / 2 * rad

  sinG2 <- sin(G)^2; cosG2 <- cos(G)^2
  sinF2 <- sin(F)^2; cosF2 <- cos(F)^2
  sinL2 <- sin(L)^2; cosL2 <- cos(L)^2

  S <- sinG2 * cosL2 + cosF2 * sinL2
  C <- cosG2 * cosL2 + sinF2 * sinL2

  w <- atan(sqrt(S / C))
  R <- sqrt(S * C) / w

  D  <- 2 * w * a
  H1 <- (3 * R - 1) / (2 * C)
  H2 <- (3 * R + 1) / (2 * S)

  d <- D * (1 + f * H1 * sinF2 * cosG2 - f * H2 * cosF2 * sinG2)
  d[!is.finite(d)] <- 0     # coincident points: S = 0 makes w, R undefined
  d
}

#' k-nearest-neighbour sets from WGS-84 coordinates.
#' @return n x k integer matrix; row i holds the indices of i's neighbours
knn_neighbors <- function(lon, lat, k) {
  n <- length(lon)
  if (k >= n) stop("k (", k, ") must be smaller than the number of points (", n, ").")
  t(vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    d <- gcdist_km(lon[i], lat[i], lon, lat)
    d[i] <- Inf
    order(d)[seq_len(k)]
  }, integer(k)))
}

# -- Geocomplexity ------------------------------------------------------------

#' Geocomplexity of one variable — local Moran decomposition, binary kNN
#' weights (ported from the package's C++ VectorGeoCMoran, specialised to the
#' binary weights geocd_vector builds for point layers: style "B", w_ij = 1).
#'
#' For each unit i with neighbour set N(i), on standardized values z:
#'   GC_i = -1/|N(i)| * ( z_i * sum_{j in N(i)} z_j
#'                        + sum_{j in N(i)} z_j * mean_{l in N(i) ∩ N(j)} z_l )
#' (the mean term is skipped when i and j share no neighbours).
#'
#' @param x  numeric vector (raw values; standardized internally)
#' @param nb n x k integer matrix from knn_neighbors()
#' @param normalize min-max rescale to [0, 1] (geocd_vector default)
#' @return numeric vector of geocomplexity values
gc_moran <- function(x, nb, normalize = TRUE) {
  s <- stats::sd(x)
  if (!is.finite(s) || s == 0)
    stop("variable is constant; geocomplexity is undefined")
  z <- (x - mean(x)) / s

  n <- length(z)
  nb_list <- lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) nb[i, ])
  out <- numeric(n)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    j <- nb_list[[i]]
    m <- length(j)
    localf <- -1 / m * z[i] * sum(z[j])
    surroundf <- 0
    for (jn in j) {
      l <- intersect(j, nb_list[[jn]])
      if (length(l) > 0) surroundf <- surroundf + z[jn] * mean(z[l])
    }
    out[i] <- localf - 1 / m * surroundf
  }

  if (normalize) {
    r <- range(out)
    if (r[2] > r[1]) out <- (out - r[1]) / (r[2] - r[1])
  }
  out
}

#' Geocomplexity of every selected variable.
#' @param df data.frame holding the variables
#' @param xvars character vector of column names
#' @return data.frame of GC_<var> columns, rows aligned with df
gc_table <- function(df, xvars, nb, normalize = TRUE) {
  out <- lapply(xvars, function(v) gc_moran(df[[v]], nb, normalize))
  names(out) <- paste0("GC_", xvars)
  as.data.frame(out, check.names = FALSE)
}

# -- Fitted curve -------------------------------------------------------------

#' Loess fit of GC on the raw variable, evaluated on a regular grid, for the
#' x-vs-GC curve panels. Falls back to a linear fit when loess cannot be
#' fitted (e.g. too few distinct x values).
gc_loess_curve <- function(x, gc, n_grid = 200) {
  grid <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = n_grid)
  fit <- tryCatch(stats::loess(gc ~ x, degree = 2, span = 0.75),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    fit <- stats::lm(gc ~ x)
    return(list(x = grid, y = stats::predict(fit, data.frame(x = grid)),
                method = "lm"))
  }
  list(x = grid, y = stats::predict(fit, data.frame(x = grid)),
       method = "loess")
}
